description: This Java class 'SimulatorHelper' manages starting and monitoring an external simulator process, primarily for UI and testing purposes. It checks for the presence of the simulator binary, launches the process, waits for TCP port readiness, and manages UI components for starting the simulator.

classes.name: SimulatorHelper
classes.description: Utility class for managing the lifecycle of a simulator process, providing methods to start the simulator, check its presence, and create related UI components.

methods.name: isBinaryHere
methods.description: Checks if the simulator binary exists at the expected location.

methods.name: startSimulator
methods.description: Starts the simulator process in a separate thread, waits for TCP port to open, and logs relevant events.

methods.name: createSimulatorComponent
methods.description: Creates a Swing UI component (button or label) based on simulator binary presence and port status, to allow user to start the simulator.

methods.name: onWindowClosed
methods.description: Terminates the simulator process if it is running when the window is closed.
